candidate_relations.reason: The ELANE mutation and rare circulating neutrophils support a genetic neutrophil disorder, but the benchmark specifically requires SCN together with a culture-confirmed hepatic abscess caused by Staphylococcus aureus.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Broad etiologic parent diagnosis only; omits severe congenital neutropenia subtype and the Staphylococcus aureus hepatic abscess.

case_quality_flags: Chronology inconsistency: an 11-month-old reportedly underwent surgery three years earlier.
